economic_rationale: Among the most liquid Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board A-shares, medium-horizon relative strength persists as capital concentrates into leaders; each year-end the annual PIT cohort is reconstituted from liquidity alone, and inside that cohort holding only the top trailing-return names at equal weight should capture cross-sectional leadership while the annual reconstitution caps survivorship and stale-membership bias. The counterparty view is that monthly rebalanced cross-sectional strength on a liquidity-screened cohort mostly buys short-term reversal after run-ups; the fixed OOS interval will decide.
rule_pseudocode: On the last open session of month M: cohort = the annual PIT cohort governing the next trade date; for each cohort instrument with >= N known closes: r = close_T / close_(T-N+1) - 1; rank rankable instruments by (-r, InstrumentId); picks = first top_n; TARGETS each pick weight 1/top_n plus every held non-pick weight 0.0. If no cohort instrument has N known closes: NO_DECISION(INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY).
parameter_rationale: Predeclared priority, not return-optimized: the half-year horizon with the most concentrated sleeve is tried first because it is the most falsifiable expression of the hypothesis; breadth is added before horizon is extended. Only the three declared variants are admitted; no grid search.

universe_policy.formation_rule: Annual PIT reconstitution (M1 architecture 6.3): at the last open session of each calendar year, rank Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board A-shares by trailing 60-open-session median amount desc with InstrumentId tie-break; require >=250 in-snapshot listed sessions, complete 60-session trailing amounts, NORMAL identity and TRADABLE formation status; take the top 50 and require at least 20 eligible names or the year fails closed; the cohort is frozen for the whole next calendar year and never backfilled. Membership is data-derived, so the intent declares no fixed instrument list.

benchmark.rationale: Same-schedule benchmark: at the first open session of each calendar year the benchmark holds that year's PIT cohort at equal weight through the same M0 kernel, fees and execution semantics, so the comparison isolates the selection decision from cohort exposure; pre-registered before any result.

risk_off_rationale: M1-D04: unallocated sleeve weight and every exit stay in zero-yield account CASH_0; no defensive ETF or bond position is ever substituted for cash by this candidate.
basic_promotion_rationale: Fail-closed pre-registered gate: full-window NAV coverage (the 2019-2022 Basic window has roughly 970 open sessions), total return within 5pp of the same-schedule equal-weight benchmark, maximum drawdown no deeper than -40%, and cumulative half-gross turnover at most 40x average equity (a monthly top-N rotation on a 50-name cohort is expected to trade materially more than a 4-ETF sleeve; the ceiling is a sanity bound, not a target). No threshold is tuned after results are seen.
oos_survivor_rationale: Survivor means 'worth M2 robustness validation', not tradability: the same benchmark-relative return floor and drawdown ceiling as Basic, applied to the fixed OOS interval only.
known_limitations: DIVIDEND_TAX_NOT_MODELED: personal-investor dividend tax is not modeled in M1 stock backtests (OQ-24); distribution returns are pre-tax, so total returns are overstated for taxable holding patterns.

PIT ST/delisting-process naming history is not available from the pinned provider; identity screens are enforced through the complete 60-session trailing window plus the top-50 liquidity rank, and STOCK identity status is attested NORMAL only within the owner-materialized cohort union.

listed_sessions counts in-snapshot trading sessions, not exchange listing age; the snapshot starts >=250 open sessions before the first formation cutoff, so the >=250 threshold is enforced identically, and long-suspended names are conservatively excluded.

The candidate universe is Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board A-shares only; ChiNext, STAR Market and BSE are excluded because the seed Instrument Master attests standard +/-10% main-board rule profiles only.
Monthly cadence misses intra-month reversals; cross-sectional strength whipsaws near turns are expected.
Basic snapshot physically ends at 2022-12-30; the fixed OOS request 2023-01-03..2025-12-31 stays unrevealed until after freeze.
source: M1 protocol section 7.2 owner-approved seed candidate; no external code or text copied.
